20 // One row of the ISO 4217 table.
21 struct iso4217_row {
22 std::string_view code; // the alphabetic code, three capitals
23 std::string_view name; // the currency's name as SIX publishes it
24 std::uint16_t numeric; // the numeric code
25 std::int8_t scale; // the minor units, or -1 where ISO gives none (N.A., and historic codes)
26 std::string_view withdrawn; // the withdrawal date as SIX gives it ("2025-03", "1989 to 1990"), empty if current
27 };
